metadata.description: Design → plan → execute → review workflow plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: init-project
plugins.description: Interview-driven project scaffolder. Creates file layout, git repo, GitHub repo, labels, milestones, and seed issues that exec-tasks can pick up on day one. Pass --auto-merge to enable automatic PR merging from day one.

plugins.name: exec-tasks
plugins.description: Review GitHub project issues, select model-appropriate coding agents (Haiku for chore/docs, Sonnet for feature/bug), and create PRs that trigger Opus-powered @claude review. Supports opt-in auto-merge.

plugins.name: plan-feature
plugins.description: Design a feature before implementation: complexity assessment, structured plan with mermaid diagrams, ADR extraction, user approval, and GitHub issue creation conforming to the workflow contract — ready for exec-tasks.

plugins.name: post-session
plugins.description: Wrap up a session by extracting durable findings (gotchas, runbooks, preferences, repeated patterns), classifying each (new skill / skill update / memory / discard), and writing the skill-worthy ones to disk after a confirmation gate.
